name: Delivery to the Gnomes
label: Quest
description: Kravel Koalbeard now has what he needs, and wants the Delicate Car Parts carried to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats, who has waited a long time…

clips.title: The story
paras: Kravel Koalbeard now has what he needs, and wants the Delicate Car Parts carried to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats, who has waited a long time for them. Kravel admits he removed a little piece from Fizzle's order, and suggests you leave it unmentioned.

Kravel Koalbeard tells you the parts are for Fizzle Brassbolts, who has been waiting a long time. Kravel confesses he took one little piece out of Fizzle's order, but feels sure it will not be missed. He calls the piece small and worthless, advises you not to bring it up, and asks you to trust him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that I have what I need, give these parts to Fizzle Brassbolts. He's been waiting a long time for them -- I'm sure he won't miss the little piece I removed from his order...
And I wouldn't bother mentioning it to him. It was small and worthless.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have something for me? That's great! Let's see it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: There they are! My hydro ratchets and repeater bolts! These will do just fine. Thank you!
